title: Earth's Day Was 1.66 Milliseconds Shorter In 2024
hook: Earth just delivered a day 1.66 milliseconds short.
closing: Tiny changes can force the clocks behind modern life to adjust.
question: Would you notice a shorter day?

segments.say: In 2024, Earth's day ran 1.66 milliseconds short. The planet is beating the standard clock.
Timekeepers have added 27 leap seconds since 1972. They have always corrected for longer days.
The chance of a negative leap second by 2035 is 40%. Faster rotation could force the first subtraction.
